rubric.role_summary: Protocol engineer leading development of core components of a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain, including consensus and state management.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Protocol engineer leading development of core components of a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain, including consensus and state management.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 5+ years of infrastructure engineering experience.
- Experience building or scaling Layer 1 blockchain systems.
- Tech lead experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Proven results in building or scaling Layer 1 blockchain performance.
- Tech lead experience planning and leading large projects with long-term impact on a single system or team.
- History of creating and applying processes and tooling to increase engineering efficiency.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
